# `company.fixed_asset_disposals`

Fixed-asset disposals: the journal entry removing the asset with its gain or loss.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this disposal. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_fixed_asset_disposals_item | items.id | Fixed-asset item disposed of. |
| `disposal_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the asset was sold or disposed of, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `proceeds_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | What the asset sold for; zero when it was scrapped. |
| `costs_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Costs of the sale, taken from the proceeds. |
| `cost_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Cost basis removed from the asset account. |
| `accumulated_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Accumulated depreciation removed from its account. |
| `gain_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Gain (positive) or loss (negative) on disposal. |
| `deposit_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account the net proceeds were debited to; null when there were none. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the amounts. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | transactions.id | Journal entry that posted the disposal; it stands while the entry is posted. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the disposal. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal who recorded it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was recorded through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that recorded it. |
